_about: The derivation layer over #87 (the rematch RECORD's home — this package defines no second record shape). Availability is a read-time projection in #124's discipline: computed when asked, stored nowhere; having been available leaves no trace. A fought rematch writes a new #30 encounter record (original fixture never edited) plus honours where #104's catalogue defines them — and NEVER re-opens a closed story flag.

availability.formula: available(opponent, now) = rematch record derived AND gate reads true
gate_inputs_defined_not_valued: story standing (derived #12 state — e.g. post-capstone for gauntlet members, #100)
rotation windows (#124 entries, when the calendar is ruled)
presence (the opponent's #93 schedule place — in person, or not at all, until a device/facility gate is ruled into #87's slot)

derivation.no_fixture: the derivation returns NOTHING — not a locked entry
derivation.record_exists_iff: a completed fixture exists — a #30 encounter record with a recorded defeat outcome (sources: #45 circuit, #100 gauntlet, #37 rivals, #151 tournament fixtures)
derivation.record_shape: #87's {ranger_id, first_defeat_flag, rungs[], repeat_rung, gate} exactly; first_defeat_flag read from the #12 flag the fixture's completion set — beaten state is never stored twice

monotonicity_law: first-defeat flags, circuit completion (#45), and story.champion_defeated (#100) are historical and monotonic — a rematch loss un-defeats nobody, costs no Fragment, re-locks no route
open_register: every rung's contents for every opponent — leader rematch teams are authored #37 party references, never generated; ZERO asserted (Hex's champion rematch undecided, per #87)
rematch housing in the postgame structure (#66 / #86 — inherited unconfirmed)
